data.one_liner: Provides unified access to device model, brand, manufacturer, UUID, OS version and user‑agent with optional persistent metadata.
data.what_it_does: The package gathers basic device information across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS and Linux. It can store a UUID securely and attach custom key‑value metadata that persists between app launches.
use_when: You need a quick way to read device details without writing platform‑specific code
You want to persist a stable UUID securely across app reinstalls
You need to attach custom metadata to the device record for analytics
avoid_when: You require fine‑grained sensor data or permissions beyond basic device info
You prefer a completely permission‑less solution (e.g., only compile‑time constants)
strengths: Cross‑platform support including desktop and web
Secure storage of UUID via flutter_secure_storage
Simple API with optional custom metadata
weaknesses: Adds a dependency on flutter_secure_storage which raises Android minSdk to 24
Limited to basic device info; no sensor or connectivity data
No built‑in caching beyond the stored UUID
data.setup_notes: Android requires minSdkVersion 24 due to flutter_secure_storage; ensure flutter_secure_storage is initialized and appropriate platform permissions are granted if using Android < API 30

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides raw device information without the extra secure‑storage layer, resulting in a lower minSdk requirement
